name: Book Evaluation Dataset v1
description: Initial evaluation dataset with 10 diverse book queries for testing StoryLand AI quality metrics

queries.query: Create a literary travel itinerary for Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen

locations.description: Georgian city where Jane Austen lived and set parts of Persuasion and Northanger Abbey
Inspiration for Mr. Darcy's Pemberley estate
Jane Austen's birthplace and home
must_visit: Jane Austen's House Museum in Chawton

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include locations directly connected to Jane Austen's life and the novel's settings
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Should reflect moderate budget and relaxed pace
quality_criteria.completeness: Must include at least 3 cities with specific landmarks
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide specific places to visit with brief descriptions
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: All locations must be real and in England
quality_criteria.engagement: Should evoke the Regency era atmosphere

queries.query: I'd like a travel itinerary based on 1984 by George Orwell. Include places from his life and the book's themes.

locations.description: Setting of 1984 and Orwell's home city
Where Orwell fought in the Spanish Civil War

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must connect to both the novel's themes and Orwell's political experiences
quality_criteria.completeness: Must include both London settings and biographical locations
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide specific addresses and visiting tips
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: Accurate locations in London and Spain
quality_criteria.engagement: Should convey the political and historical significance

queries.query: Plan a luxurious trip based on The Great Gatsby. I want the full Jazz Age experience.

locations.description: Heart of the Jazz Age and Gatsby's glamorous world
Inspiration for East and West Egg

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must feature 1920s Jazz Age locations and Gatsby settings
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Must include luxury accommodations and upscale experiences
quality_criteria.completeness: Should cover Manhattan and Long Island with specific venues
quality_criteria.actionability: Should suggest specific luxury hotels and restaurants
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: Accurate NYC and Long Island geography
quality_criteria.engagement: Should capture the glamour and tragedy of the Jazz Age

queries.query: Create an itinerary for Les Misérables. I'm traveling with family and need accessible locations.

locations.description: Primary setting of Les Misérables
Where Jean Valjean became a factory owner and mayor

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include key Paris locations from the novel
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Must ensure all locations are wheelchair accessible and family-friendly
quality_criteria.completeness: Should provide comprehensive Paris coverage plus northern France
quality_criteria.actionability: Must include accessibility information for each location
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: Accurate Paris districts and northern French towns
quality_criteria.engagement: Should convey the historical and emotional weight of the story

queries.query: I want to visit locations from War and Peace. I'm interested in both Russian and French settings.

locations.description: Central setting for the Rostov family
High society scenes and Bolkonsky estates
Site of the famous battle

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include both Russian estates and European battle sites
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Should balance Russian and international locations
quality_criteria.completeness: Must cover Moscow, St. Petersburg, and at least one battle location
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide historical context for each site
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: Accurate locations across Russia and Central Europe
quality_criteria.engagement: Should convey the epic scope of the novel

queries.query: I'm on a tight budget but want to see the Da Vinci Code locations in Paris and London.

locations.description: Where the mystery begins
Home to Westminster Abbey and Temple Church

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include key mystery locations from the novel
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Must provide budget alternatives like free museums days
quality_criteria.completeness: Should cover Paris and London with specific churches and museums
quality_criteria.actionability: Should include money-saving tips and free visiting times
quality_criteria.engagement: Should maintain the mystery and intrigue of the novel

queries.query: Plan a magical Harry Potter trip for my family with kids. We need kid-friendly activities.

locations.description: Magical London locations
Hogwarts filming locations
Where J.K. Rowling wrote Harry Potter

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include both film locations and Rowling's writing locations
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Must be child-friendly with interactive experiences
quality_criteria.completeness: Should cover London, Oxford, and Scotland
quality_criteria.actionability: Should include ticket booking info and kid-friendly logistics
quality_criteria.engagement: Should capture the magical atmosphere for children

book.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
book.author: Stieg Larsson

queries.query: Create a Millennium trilogy tour of Sweden. I love museums and want a fast-paced itinerary.

locations.description: Primary setting of the trilogy
Inspiration for the fictional Hedestad

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include Stockholm's Södermalm and key trilogy locations
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Should be fast-paced with efficient routing and museum focus
quality_criteria.completeness: Should cover Stockholm thoroughly with day trips
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide specific walking routes and museum hours
quality_criteria.engagement: Should convey the dark, atmospheric tone of Nordic noir

queries.query: I want to visit both London and Paris locations from A Tale of Two Cities.

locations.description: Home of Jarvis Lorry and the Manettes
Revolutionary Paris and Bastille

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must include both cities with Revolutionary War connections
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Should balance time between London and Paris
quality_criteria.completeness: Must include historical sites from both French Revolution and Victorian London
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide historical context for each location
quality_criteria.engagement: Should capture the revolutionary atmosphere and emotional depth

queries.query: Plan a spiritual journey following The Alchemist's path from Spain to Egypt.

locations.description: Santiago's starting point in Andalusia
Where Santiago meets the crystal merchant
Desert oasis where Santiago meets Fatima
Location of Santiago's treasure and the Pyramids

quality_criteria.book_relevance: Must follow Santiago's journey from Spain through Morocco to Egypt
quality_criteria.preference_adherence: Should include spiritual and contemplative experiences
quality_criteria.completeness: Must cover all major stops in the journey with desert experiences
quality_criteria.actionability: Should provide practical desert travel tips and cultural guidance
quality_criteria.geographical_accuracy: Accurate locations across Spain, Morocco, and Egypt
quality_criteria.engagement: Should evoke the philosophical and spiritual themes of the book

scoring_functions.name: book_relevance
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates if itinerary locations are connected to the book's settings, themes, or author

criteria.5: All locations strongly connected to book

scoring_functions.name: preference_adherence
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates if recommendations respect user preferences (budget, pace, accessibility)

scoring_functions.name: completeness
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates if itinerary includes comprehensive details (cities, landmarks, author sites)

scoring_functions.name: actionability
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates if itinerary is practical with specific places and logistics

scoring_functions.name: geographical_accuracy
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates accuracy of locations and geographical information

scoring_functions.name: engagement
scoring_functions.description: Evaluates if descriptions are engaging and evoke the spirit of the book

usage_notes: This dataset provides expected outputs and quality criteria for evaluation
Each query includes user preferences to test preference adherence
Books span multiple genres, time periods, and geographical regions
Expected outputs can be used as gold standard for evaluation
Quality criteria provide guidance for manual or automated scoring
